P01.rationale: No portrait photo of a founder or person appears anywhere on the page; the right column contains only large typographic numbers and a QR code.

P05.rationale: There is no client portrait image in the case study; the named client 'Martina Ammon' is referenced only in text with no accompanying photo.

P07.rationale: A single pull-quote testimonial with attribution is present, but there is no logo wall, rating cards, or review grid to constitute a fuller social-proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: The right column features very large, oversized typographic numerals ('24 Std.', '>200.000 €', '4') used as dominant decorative display elements.

P11.rationale: Concrete before/after data metrics (24 hours → minutes, >200,000 € savings, 4 automated processes) are displayed as large typographic callouts, though no chart or visual graph is used.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with structured text sections on the left and large metric callouts on the right, though it lacks the layered density of the reference editorial pages.

P13.rationale: The page is largely flat white with minimal texture; a faint geometric shape appears in the upper-right corner but provides negligible atmospheric quality.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no photography at all, relying entirely on typography and data, so generic stock imagery is absent but the lack of any specific imagery reduces authenticity.

N08.rationale: The lower-left quadrant of the left column has a noticeable empty region below the 'Ergebnis' section, leaving some purposeless dead space.

N10.rationale: There are no photos with overlaid text and no awkward inset gaps; all text sits cleanly on the white background.
